stories.title: Notre Dame director to lead presentation on AI at Seton Hill University in Greensburg
stories.simple_summary: A director from Notre Dame will give a talk about artificial intelligence at a university in Pennsylvania. This is an educational event for people to learn more about AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters if you live nearby and want to attend a lecture. There's nothing you need to do otherwise.

stories.title: Will artificial intelligence make caddies a thing of the past?
stories.simple_summary: Some people wonder if AI might replace golf caddies, the people who carry clubs and help golfers during rounds. The headline asks whether this job could disappear.
stories.why_it_matters: If you play golf or know caddies, this is worth thinking about. For most people, this doesn't directly affect your daily life yet.

stories.title: Why mandating AI use in the workplace can backfire
stories.simple_summary: A newspaper article explains that forcing workers to use AI tools can sometimes cause problems instead of helping. Bosses need to introduce new tools carefully.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small business, this reminds you to involve your employees when adopting AI instead of simply ordering them to use new systems.

stories.title: Tempted to ask AI about your skin? Think again
stories.simple_summary: AI chatbots might not give you reliable advice about skin problems or skin health. A newspaper warns that you should talk to a real doctor instead.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have a skin concern, ask your doctor or dermatologist rather than asking an AI tool. Don't rely on AI for medical advice.

stories.title: Inside Anthropic’s Urgent Hunt for A.I. Computing Power
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, a company that makes AI, is working very hard to get access to more powerful computers to run their AI systems. These computers are expensive and hard to find.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who work in AI companies. You don't need to do anything in response.

stories.title: Omen AI adds liquid know-how in $16 million Aquatic Labs acquisition
stories.simple_summary: Two small tech companies joined together in a $16 million deal. Both companies were trying to solve problems with water usage in large computer facilities.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies. Unless you own a large data center, this doesn't affect you.

stories.title: OpenAI-funded Biossil snags Theriva's unwanted antibiotic degrader portfolio for up to $91M
stories.simple_summary: A company called Biossil, which is funded by OpenAI, is buying another company's research about breaking down antibiotics. The deal could be worth up to $91 million.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and pharmaceutical companies. This is about very specialized medical research, not something that affects everyday life yet.

stories.title: Marvell to buy Lumentum in all-stock deal, a massive bet on AI connectivity
stories.simple_summary: Marvell, a computer chip company, is buying another company called Lumentum. The deal shows that big tech companies are spending enormous amounts of money on AI-related equipment.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors in tech stocks. If you have a 401k with tech company investments, this might indirectly affect you very slightly.

stories.title: 2 days till TechCrunch Founder Summit: Boston founders don’t need a Silicon Valley address to build something big
stories.simple_summary: TechCrunch is holding a conference for business founders in Boston on November 4. They are offering discounts on tickets to get people to attend.
stories.why_it_matters: This only matters if you're a business founder interested in attending a conference. Most people don't need to pay attention.

stories.title: OpenAI is finally merging ChatGPT’s chat and Work tabs
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is changing how ChatGPT works by combining its chat section and work section into one. This is a small technical reorganization of how the software is structured.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT, this is just a minor change to how the interface looks and works. Nothing major is happening.

stories.title: AI, Taxes and Real Estate Collide in San Francisco’s BART Crisis
stories.simple_summary: A news article connects three big topics: artificial intelligence, taxes, and real estate. It looks at how these things are affecting San Francisco's public transportation system.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you live in San Francisco or own property there, this article is mostly about local issues. It probably won't affect you directly.

stories.title: OpenAI might rebrand its data centers as ‘AI compute campuses’
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is thinking about calling their large computer facilities "AI compute campuses" instead of "data centers." The company wants to make these facilities sound more appealing to the communities near them.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect you. It's just a name change by one company to help with public relations in their neighborhoods.
